dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: III
dialogues.text: Why don't I remember writing all this?

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: III
dialogues.text: The place is giving me headaches. This is very strange... I'm probably under the influence of something.

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: III
dialogues.text: I felt like I was waking from a nightmare. I'm very agitated, and I'm losing track of things that happened recently.

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: III
dialogues.text: I'd better erase all records and leave, just in case.

dialogues.speaker: Remnant Records: III
dialogues.text: Wait, if I'm destroying the records anyway, why am I still writing this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Could it be that he just ran away?

choices.text: He might have been met with something frightening.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we didn't see anything scary after activating the device. Why's that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And he destroyed most of the records too. It's almost as if he was covering something up...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe people see different things, depending on their state of mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, he was the one leaving us the records and providing helpful information...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But he's still pretty irresponsible, so Paimon's gonna call him something dumb, like... "The Deserting Dumbo"!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Anyway, we've figured this mystery out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. The whole story is actually quite simple, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As for the device buried in the seashore, it's not all that dangerous, and it should stop working soon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, since we don't see something like it every day, {NICKNAME}, do you wanna try another challenge?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should enjoy the Mirage for as long as you wish! The cooking ingredients can wait.

choices.text: He was influenced by the device.
